definitions.explanation: A train or bus that skips some stops to provide faster service.

examples.japanese: {急行|きゅうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{急行|きゅうこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What time is the next express?

examples.japanese: {急行|きゅうこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}けば→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{着|つ}きます→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: If you take the express, you'll arrive quickly.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{急行|きゅうこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The express doesn't stop at this station, so please go to the next station.

examples.japanese: {急行|きゅうこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{追加|ついか}→追加：04060_tsuika⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧⟦{列車|れっしゃ}→列車：01670_ressha⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{着|つ}く→着く：00680_tsuku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The express costs extra, but it's convenient because it arrives faster than the local train.

notes:
{急行|きゅうこう} refers to express trains that skip some stations for faster service.

TRAIN TYPES (slowest to fastest):
- ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧/⟦{各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}→各駅停車：15471_kakuekiteisha⟧: local (all stops)
- ⟦{快速|かいそく}→快速：09213_kaisoku⟧: rapid
- {急行|きゅうこう}: express
- ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧: limited express
- ⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧: bullet train

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {急行|きゅうこう}⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧: express train
- {急行|きゅうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to take the express
- {急行|きゅうこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go by express

USAGE:
Some express services require ⟦{特急券|とっきゅうけん}→特急券：15799_tokkyuuken⟧ (express ticket) or ⟦{急行券|きゅうこうけん}→急行券：noentry⟧ in addition to the basic fare. Private railways often have different naming conventions.
